items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I met Erskine Hawkins in Birmingham, Alabama.

ctx.x: Did you get a chance to meet at that time Benny? You say you played "Tuxedo Junction." How about Erskine Hawkins, or even Glenn Miller?
I met Erskine Hawkins in Birmingham, Alabama.
So you met Erskine before he left Birmingham.
